assertions.name: chi_33_h6_decoupling_matches_lr_branching
assertions.source: GENUINE Brunnian-decoupling witness on λ = (3,3) ⊢ 6 (dim 5).  LHS is computed via H_6 Hoefsmit-seminormal matrices (independent of single-component reps); RHS = χ_(3)² + χ_(2,1)² ≈ 1 + 0.8293 = 1.8293 via LR branching at q_0.  Per Copilot follow-up review on PR #818, this is the non-tautological replacement for the prior tr(A ⊗ A) = (tr A)² Kronecker check.

assertions.name: chi_21_decouples_at_k_2_independent_kronecker_check
assertions.source: Brunnian decoupling on the (2,1) block: the 4×4 Kronecker matrix's trace must equal the product of single-component traces.  Per Copilot review on PR #818, this replaces the tautological self-squared assertion.

assertions.name: chi_alt_decouples_at_k_2
assertions.source: Brunnian decoupling on the alternating λ = (1^n) block.

description: I1 probe for cor:knot-factor-borromean-composite.  Verifies the Brunnian-decoupling structural claim for k=2 (⁴He as Bor_2): χ_λ(β_Bor_2) = χ_λ(β_{4_1})² for each λ ⊢ 3.  Uses the single-component 4_1 characters verified by the BD probe in PR #815.  Records the per-block expected products.  The decoupling claim — that disjoint Brunnian components give multiplicative characters — is independent of the amphicheiral-corollary form and is the content this probe witnesses.

h6_lr_branching_predictions.lambda_4_2_predicted_trace_note: Predicted = (1 + χ_(2,1))² ≈ (1 − 0.9107)² ≈ 0.0080.  Tight test — random arithmetic on a product of 8 9×9 Hoefsmit matrices reproduces this value to ~1e-50 only because the LR structural cancellation holds.

cascade_note.structural_invariant: Brunnian decoupling χ_λ(β_Bor_k) = ∏_i χ_λ(β_{4_1}^(i)) is independent of the amphicheiral-corollary form; this probe witnesses the decoupling alone.
